description: Raw envelope texts, read as TEXT and never parsed before the code under test. Each file is a template: the single "$SIGNATURE" placeholder is replaced at run time with a signature over the canonical bytes of manifest/valid-stable.json made with a throwaway key, so no signature is committed. Plain JSON.parse of every file yields that same valid envelope (key_id fk_x7k2q_2026a), because JSON.parse keeps the last duplicate; that is the DF-001 gap. strict: what test/support/strict-json.ts does (ok, or the StrictJsonError kind). client: clientVerify result for compiled profile x7k2q, channel stable. import: import reference result for the request body {"envelope": <file text>}, profile x7k2q with fk_x7k2q_2026a registered and nothing published.
